deviations_from_adr: G-2 (ADR spec.contract §8): coherenceHash uses SHA-256 of canonical JSON (alphabetically sorted keys, depth-first). ADR requires determinism and desync-catching — both satisfied. Algorithm is realization-owned choice per G-2.

G-1 (ADR spec.contract §8): implementation and bundle are in-memory TypeScript types (not new DB tables). ADR §15 explicitly permits projections without authority-store; no migration added because B-2 entities are pure projections as required. If persistence is needed later, a migration will be added then.

G-4 (ADR spec.contract §8): simulation mode-1 uses a GatewayRoute[] DI port for routing rules rather than parsing BPMN XML to extract gateway conditions. lintBpmn (T-0027) is called first as the sole BPMN linter (FR-B5-3). The route-calculation itself uses the deterministic gateway evaluator against the provided routes — this is a valid realization of 'deterministic attribute traversal through gateways/DMN' per §8.1.

No migration 060 added: ADR §15 and spec G-1 allow projections to be in-memory/derived. The phase-machine and bundle are TypeScript types without new DB tables. Migration 059 (B-1) is the last migration added to date.
notes: B-2..B-5 all implemented in single file src/core/implementation-loop.ts. 51 unit tests covering AC-1..AC-19 (AC-7/8/12/16/20 covered by fitness checks). 3 fitness checks (b2/b4/b5) all green with self-tests. 2091 existing tests pass, 0 regressions.
